book.title: Halloween Mazes for Kids
book.subtitle: 50 Mazes with a Spooky Story, Ages 6 to 10

scenes.title: The Attic Hunt
scenes.text: The costume box is up in the attic somewhere, behind everything else. Jim has until dark.

scenes.title: The Stuck Zipper
scenes.text: The ghost suit is inside out and the zipper will not budge. The sewing box is all the way across the room.

scenes.title: Mirror Practice
scenes.text: Two white swirls, one on each cheek. Now Jim needs the tall mirror to see if they came out spooky or silly.

scenes.title: Soup Before Sweets
scenes.text: Soup before sweets, says Mom. Jim's bowl is steaming away on the far side of the kitchen.

scenes.title: The Missing Flashlight
scenes.text: The flashlight has rolled under the couch again. Get past the pillows and the boots and fish it out.

scenes.title: The Candy Bucket
scenes.text: The pumpkin bucket is up on the closet shelf where Jim can only just see it. Time to go and get it down.

scenes.title: Boots By The Door
scenes.text: One boot is waiting by the door. The other is hiding under the stairs, and Jim is hopping.

scenes.title: The Front Door
scenes.text: The porch light is on and the night smells like wet leaves. Only the coats to get past now.

scenes.title: Down The Garden Path
scenes.text: Wet leaves have covered every single stepping stone. The little apple tree is right at the bottom of the garden.

scenes.title: The Squeaky Gate
scenes.text: Squeeeak. That is the gate at the end of the yard, and the flower pots are in the way.

scenes.title: The First Porch
scenes.text: A grinning pumpkin sits by the steps of the very first house. Jim practises saying trick or treat on the way up.

scenes.title: The Barking Dog
scenes.text: The dog behind the fence is barking his head off and wagging his tail at the same time. Past him, quietly.

scenes.title: The Sprinkler Surprise
scenes.text: Somebody has left the sprinkler on. A wet ghost is not a scary ghost, so time the dashes carefully.

scenes.title: Between The Hedges
scenes.text: These hedges are taller than Dad. Find the gaps and keep going.

scenes.title: Sheets On The Line
scenes.text: White sheets flap on the line, and for a second Jim thinks they are other ghosts. The back gate is behind them.

scenes.title: The Corner Store
scenes.text: Orange lights fill the corner store window. The candy counter is at the back, down one very narrow aisle.

scenes.title: The Pile Of Leaves
scenes.text: Somebody raked the whole street into one pile. Crunch a trail through it, and hold on to that bucket.

scenes.title: A Crowd Of Pirates
scenes.text: Pirates and robots everywhere, all shouting at once. The next porch is somewhere on the other side of them.

scenes.title: The Spider Mailbox
scenes.text: A rubber spider swings from the mailbox. Jim knows it is rubber. Jim still ducks.

scenes.title: The Long Driveway
scenes.text: The last house on the street sits a long way back. It is a long walk for one sweet, but Jim is going anyway.

scenes.title: Into The Park
scenes.text: The park gate is open and the sky has gone purple. These trees looked much shorter this morning.

scenes.title: The Duck Pond
scenes.text: Ducks bob about under the first stars. The stone bridge is on the far side and the mud in between is deep.

scenes.title: The Pumpkin Patch
scenes.text: Rows and rows of fat pumpkins, every one of them sitting in mud. The wagon is parked at the far end.

scenes.title: The Hay Bale Maze
scenes.text: The hay bales are stacked higher than Jim's head. Somewhere in the middle of them, a lantern is glowing.

scenes.title: The Quiet School Yard
scenes.text: The swings are moving and nobody is on them. Across the blacktop, somebody has left the gate open.

scenes.title: The Skeleton Band
scenes.text: A skeleton band is playing kazoos on the bandstand, badly. Jim would like a closer look.

scenes.title: The Bat Alley
scenes.text: Bats swoop over the alley lights, squeaking away. They are only saying hello. Probably.

scenes.title: The Fountain Square
scenes.text: Water splashes in the old stone fountain. There is a candy stand on the other side of all these benches.

scenes.title: The Costume Parade
scenes.text: Drums. The parade has filled the whole street, and Jim is on the wrong side of it.

scenes.title: The Library Steps
scenes.text: There is a treat bowl by the library door and it is going fast. Paper bats swing overhead the whole way up.

scenes.title: The Old Orchard
scenes.text: The old apple trees lean right out over the grass. The stone wall is somewhere past them.

scenes.title: The Cobweb Shed
scenes.text: Silver webs cover the shed door, every inch of it. There is a lantern in there, and Jim wants it.

scenes.title: The Foggy Lane
scenes.text: Fog has come down thick in the lane. Follow the fence posts and the streetlight will turn up eventually.

scenes.title: The Black Cat
scenes.text: A black cat has sat down in the middle of the lane and started purring. She is not moving for anybody.

scenes.title: The Graveyard Fence
scenes.text: Old stones stand in rows behind the iron fence. Jim keeps close to the fence and does not look twice.

scenes.title: The Creaky Bridge
scenes.text: The wooden bridge creaks over a chuckling stream. Some of these boards are dry and some are not.

scenes.title: The Whispering Willow
scenes.text: The willow trails its branches right across the path. They only feel like fingers.

scenes.title: The Lighthouse Path
scenes.text: The lighthouse beam swings over the rocks and back again. The keeper keeps a candy dish at the top of those steps.

scenes.title: The Dancing Skeletons
scenes.text: Clack, clack, clack. The skeletons are tap dancing in the old barn and the fiddler shows no sign of stopping.

scenes.title: The Owl Loft
scenes.text: A very round owl blinks down from the hay loft. Jim blinks back, then goes looking for the open door.

scenes.title: The Mansion Gates
scenes.text: Tall iron gates at the top of the hill, and one of them is open. Jim just has to work out which.

scenes.title: The Hedge Maze
scenes.text: A maze inside a maze. There is a stone bench at the middle of this one, for anybody who reaches it.

scenes.title: The Grand Porch
scenes.text: Cobwebs hang right across the enormous porch. Behind them somewhere is a brass bell the size of Jim's head.

scenes.title: The Great Hall
scenes.text: Candles flicker all the way down the great hall. A ghost waltzes past and does not even look at Jim.

scenes.title: The Cellar Steps
scenes.text: Jars of pickles line the cellar wall, hundreds of them. The light switch is past all these crates.

scenes.title: The Tower Stairs
scenes.text: The stairs curl up and up and up. The bats do not mind sharing, so long as Jim keeps left.

scenes.title: The Dusty Ballroom
scenes.text: A music box is still playing in the dusty ballroom. Nobody has been here for years and it is still playing.

scenes.title: The Mansion Attic
scenes.text: Trunks, old hats, and a smell like the back of a wardrobe. The round window is at the far end.

scenes.title: The Last Big House
scenes.text: Paper ghosts float over the last big porch on the hill. Final door of the night, and the bucket is nearly full.

scenes.title: Home At Last
scenes.text: Jim's own porch light is glowing warm and yellow. Reach the steps, tip out the bucket, and start counting.

endPage.title: The End
endPage.text: Tip it all out on the floor and count. Jim always does.

howToPlay: Find a path from Jim to the candy bucket.
You cannot walk through a wall.
Pick up as much candy as you can on the way.
Tick one box for every candy you get.
Write how many you got in the Total box.
See how close you came to the “Best possible” score.
Stuck? The answers are at the back.
dedication: For everyone who takes the long way round
because that is where the good sweets are.
